text:
rachael: FYI starting canary for search-indexer v4.0.0 -> v4.1.0 in change-window-3 (cohort: us-east-a). small ramp (10% -> 30%). tagging @devraj @mike-oncall

deploy-bot: Deploy kicked off by rachael — canary cohort us-east-a (1/5) — version: v4.1.0 — ramp: 10%

devraj: eyeballing SLO dashboards, baseline p95 ~180ms. will watch for error budget burn and 5xx. link: https://console.redwood/dash/search-indexer?slo=p95&window=30m

srebot: Warning: slo.p95 exceeded soft-threshold (search-indexer, us-east-a, 3m) — sample count: 18 — action: created alert #obs-499 and pinged oncall

mike-oncall: on it. can we reduce canary traffic to 0 in us-east-a while we triage?

rachael: hold next wave and set canary weight to 0 for us-east-a. @deploy-bot set-weight us-east-a 0

deploy-bot: Command acknowledged. Cohort us-east-a weight set to 0. Further waves paused.

devraj: quick traces show increased tail latency at request fanout step to kv-store. sample trace ids: trace-7801, trace-7807

srebot: Observability note: KV-store miss-rate up by +7% at 16:03 UTC, correlates with p95 spike

rachael: checking node logs for GC/compaction overlap. posting snippet:
```
2026-03-28T16:02:58Z compactor: started compaction shard-12
2026-03-28T16:03:01Z serve: latency p95=412ms
2026-03-28T16:03:05Z compactor: finished, reclaimed 48MB
```

devraj: compaction overlap looks likely. two nodes in cohort were on a compaction schedule at the ramp moment. recommend rollback just for us-east-a and reschedule compaction window

mike-oncall: agreed. initiate rollback for us-east-a to v4.0.0 and open a follow-up ticket for compaction jittering

rachael: @deploy-bot rollback us-east-a v4.0.0 — reason: compaction-induced tail latency

deploy-bot: Rollback started for cohort us-east-a. ETA ~35s. Notifying oncall and pausing global ramp.

srebot: Incident created: INC-20260328-search-tail-latency. linked obs ticket: #obs-499. assigned to oncall.

devraj: will patch compaction schedule: add random jitter +/- 5m and reduce chunk size for shard compaction. PR: https://git.company/repo/pull/1256

mike-oncall: monitoring 5xx and p95. if metrics return to baseline within 12m, plan to re-run canary with compaction guardrails and a slower ramp (5% step, 3m between steps)

deploy-bot: Rollback complete for us-east-a. Cohort nodes returned to v4.0.0

rachael: p95 trending to baseline. holding change-window tilt until postmortem notes and PR merged

devraj: added initial notes to ticket and will attach telemetry diffs in 10m

mike-oncall: good catch. leaving the hold for now. will unhold once we see stable p95 for 15 consecutive minutes

rachael: updating release notes draft: adding a known-issue entry about compaction overlap and canary ramp recommendation

deploy-bot: Reminder: change-window-3 ends in 1h20m
achael: thanks everyone — will follow up with the post-action checklist in the ticket and schedule a short retro
